perfil: Hailing from the frozen land of Norstheim, she is an elite warrior of the Sentinel of Dawn. A master of all weapons, she pays extra attention to cases involving Nocturn Eterna.

habilidades.b: Wields the bayonet to attack targets of different distances in different ways.

tpl.s: Wields the bayonet to attack targets of different distances in different ways. Slashes nearby targets with combo strikes: Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 6: ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Shoots distant targets: Strike 1: ⟦6⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦7⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: Fires lasers, dealing ⟦8⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto ATK DMG.

Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩ and generate a Cyclone, dealing ⟪0⟫ x3 of ATK as AoE Ventus Mark DMG.

builds.d: A melee build that generates Whirlwinds to destroy projectiles when activating a skill or Auto Attack.
A build that enhances the ranged DMG of skills and Auto Attacks, significantly boosting ranged DPS.

l.b: For a short duration after the Main Skill is cast, combo slashes of Auto Attacks can generate a Whirlwind to deal DMG. The Whirlwind can track and attack enemies.
l.s: Within 4s after casting Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill), when the next Auto Attack slash deals DMG, it generates a Whirlwind that deal ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Auto Attack DMG every 0.5s for 4s. The Whirlwind can track and attack enemies, triggering ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, generates multiple Whirlwinds to deal DMG. The Whirlwind can increase its Attack Range over time.
l.s: When casting Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill), generates 2 Whirlwinds that deal ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Auto Attack DMG every 0.5s for 4s.  The Whirlwind can increase its Attack Range over time and trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: The Main Skill's slashes can block enemy projectile attacks. Increases Wraith's DMG dealt to nearby targets.
l.s: Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill)'s slashes will stir up a storm, blocking hostile projectiles. Also increases Wraith's Auto Attack DMG to nearby targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by the Main Skill's slashes. Increases Wraith's Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: Increases the slash Skill DMG of Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧. Increases Wraith's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When the Main Skill's slashes deal DMG, increases Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill)'s slashes deal DMG, increases Wraith's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: The Main Skill fires homing lasers instead of bullets, dealing AoE DMG. Increases the Ventus DMG dealt by Wraith's shots.
l.s: Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill) fires homing lasers instead of bullets, dealing AoE DMG. Increases the Ventus DMG dealt by Wraith's shots by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the number of bullets fired when holding to cast the Main Skill continuously. Increases the Ventus DMG dealt by all Wraith's shots.
l.s: When holding to cast Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill), each round fires ⟦0⟧ more bullets than the previous one. Increases the Ventus DMG dealt by Wraith's bullets by ⟦1⟧. Can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: For a short duration after Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill) is cast, enhances Wraith's weapon, during which her Auto Attack shots fire lasers to deal DMG.
l.s: Within 3s after casting Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill), enhances Wraith's weapon. Each additional Main Skill stack consumed extends the duration by 3s. While Wraith's weapon is enhanced, her Auto Attack shots fire lasers, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ventus Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered once per second.

l.b: When casting Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill), increases the Skill DMG of Main Skill's shots.
l.s: When casting Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill), increases the Main Skill's shot Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 1s, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: When Wraith's shots deal DMG, increases Skill DMG.
l.s: When Wraith's shots deal DMG, increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, up to 8 stacks. This effect can only be triggered 1 times per second. The effect ends if the Main Skill is cast.

l.b: Each Ventus Trekker in the squad increase Wraith's ATK.
l.s: Each Ventus Trekker in the squad increases Wraith's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the number of Wraith's dodges. Increases ATK when dodging.
l.s: Wraith can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 4s.

l.b: When Wraith triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases Ventus DMG.
l.s: When Wraith triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate's shuttling speed. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Increases Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate)'s shuttling speed. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: After casting the Ultimate, increases Wraith's ATK.
l.s: After casting Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate), increases Wraith's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: When the Ultimate unfolds its domain, pulls in targets. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate) unfolds its domain, pulls in targets. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

builds.d: A build that allows skills to generate ground fissures and Whirlwinds, boosting sustained DPS.
A build that enhances skill range and DMG, boosting burst DMG potential.

l.b: The Support Skill shoots and generates a Tornado that tracks the target, dealing multiple instances of DMG.
l.s: Rolling Bungee (Support Skill)'s shot creates a tornado that tracks the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG every 0.5s for 8s. Can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: The Support Skill slashes and cracks the ground, dealing multiple instances of DMG.
l.s: Rolling Bungee (Support Skill)'s slashes create a rift in the ground, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG every 0.5s for a total of 8s. Can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, there is a chance to fire lasers to deal DMG.
l.s: When Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) deals DMG, there is a 50% chance to fire lasers, dealing ⟦0⟧ of Wraith's ATK as Ventus Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, increases Wraith's ATK.
l.s: When Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) deals DMG, increases Wraith's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 4s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, increases Wraith's Skill DMG.
l.s: Casting Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) increases Wraith's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: The Support Skill slashes and then performs a horizontal sweep, dealing DMG in a large area.
l.s: Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) triggers an additional slash, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ventus Skill DMG in a large area.

l.b: The Support Skill fires additional lasers.
l.s: Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) fires ⟦0⟧ additional lasers.

l.b: When the Support Skill's slashes deal DMG, increases the Skill DMG of this Support Skill's shots.
l.s: When the slashes of Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) deal DMG, increases the Skill DMG of this Support Skill's shots by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 9 times.

l.b: The fewer targets the Support Skill's slashes hit, the higher the DMG dealt.
l.s: Increases the Ventus DMG of Rolling Bungee (Support Skill)'s slashes by ⟦0⟧. If only one target is hit, increases this bonus to ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's DMG.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of the slashes and shots of Rolling Bungee (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Each Ventus Trekker in the squad increase Wraith's ATK.
l.s: Each Ventus Trekker in the squad increases Wraith's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's DMG dealt to targets inflicted with ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases Rolling Bungee (Support Skill)'s Ventus DMG dealt to targets inflicted with ⟨Ventus Mark⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When a Ventus squadmate triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, there is a chance to create a Whirlwind, dealing multiple instances of DMG.
l.s: When a Ventus Trekker other than Wraith triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, there is a 50% chance to create a Whirlwind, dealing ⟦0⟧ of Wraith's ATK as AoE Skill DMG every 0.5s for a total of 8s. The Whirlwind can track and attack enemies. This effect can only be triggered once every 3s.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate's shuttling speed. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Increases Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate)'s shuttling speed. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: After casting the Ultimate, increases Wraith's ATK.
l.s: After casting Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate), increases Wraith's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: When the Ultimate unfolds its domain, pulls in targets. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate) unfolds its domain, pulls in targets. Also increases Wraith's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.
